usage: A woodpecker is a bird that pecks at tree trunks to find insects.
Use it as a noun to refer to this specific kind of bird.
You can use it when talking about birds in a forest.
It can be the subject of a sentence, e.g. “The woodpecker is pecking on the tree.”
It can also be the object, e.g. “I saw a woodpecker.”
